cases.description: Every exported Firebase UID has exactly one identity_map row and one Supabase auth user; no orphan domain foreign keys
Email login, Google login, password recovery, logout, refresh, and disabled-user denial succeed with matching identity
Private profile count/hash and public profile count/hash match; emails are never anonymously readable
Every userTag resolves to the same profile and /@:userTag remains stable
Published nota count and canonical row hashes match, including content, citations, sub-page edges, timestamps, IDs and author mappings
Anonymous /p/:notaId and /@:userTag/:notaId responses match Firebase for a deterministic sample plus all edge-case rows
Comment count/hash, parent edges and author mappings match; reply_count equals derived child count
Create, reply, edit, delete and moderator delete preserve authorization and counters
Expanded nota/comment vote rows match legacy maps or notaVotes and aggregate counts equal derived counts
Add, switch and remove vote are idempotent and transactionally update aggregates
Viewer markers and view aggregates reconcile; duplicate identity mappings are zero
Repeated authenticated view increments total each time and unique viewers once; anonymous view does not dereference a null UID
Subscription count/hash and UID mapping match; email is not exposed by RLS
Authenticated subscribe is idempotent and anonymous subscribe is denied
All catalogued event names have an explicit keep/rename/drop mapping and privacy owner approval
Mapped events arrive once with no raw email, token, content body, or service key
Anon/authenticated/owner/non-owner/service test suite proves least privilege for every table
Firebase rollback mirror watermark equals the Supabase commit watermark and reverse reconciliation has zero missing/conflicting writes
